roles.name: Client
goals: Leave editing notes on selected photos

workflows.name: Find and inspect

steps.action: Search for 'WINDOW'
steps.result: Window Light is the only result

steps.action: Open Window Light and confirm title, category, and image match
steps.result: Photo details displayed correctly

steps.action: Return to Gallery and confirm search remains
steps.result: Search term persists in input field

steps.action: Clear search and select Outdoor category
steps.result: Seven photos appear

workflows.success: Client successfully found and inspected photos using search and category filtering
workflows.failure: Search or category filter not working correctly
workflows.recovery: Clear search, reload page, or check browser console for errors

workflows.name: Select, annotate, and persist

steps.action: Open Golden Hour photo and add it to shortlist
steps.result: Photo added to shortlist, count updates

steps.action: Add note: 'Please soften the background'
steps.result: Note saved locally without separate save button

steps.action: Add four other photos to shortlist
steps.result: Five photos selected, count updates

steps.action: Attempt to add a sixth photo
steps.result: Limit explained through accessible feedback, original five remain

steps.action: Open My Selection and confirm same five records and note
steps.result: Selection and notes displayed correctly

steps.action: Reload page
steps.result: Selection and note persist across reload

workflows.success: Client successfully selected, annotated, and persisted photos in shortlist
workflows.failure: Selection limit not enforced or notes not persisted
workflows.recovery: Remove a photo to make room, then reload page to confirm persistence

workflows.name: Remove and replace

steps.action: Remove one photo from shortlist
steps.result: Photo removed, count updates everywhere

steps.action: Add a different photo to replace the removed one
steps.result: New photo added, correct five in sample-data order

steps.action: Reopen removed photo and confirm note remains
steps.result: Previously saved note still attached to photo

workflows.success: Client successfully replaced a photo in shortlist while preserving notes
workflows.failure: Photo removal doesn't update count or note not preserved
workflows.recovery: Re-add the photo, remove it again, and verify note persists

workflows.name: Submit and lock

steps.action: Attempt to submit with fewer than five photos
steps.result: Submission blocked, explanation shown

steps.action: Select exactly five photos
steps.result: Five photos selected, submission enabled

steps.action: Open submission dialog and cancel
steps.result: Nothing changes, selection remains intact

steps.action: Open submission dialog again and confirm submission
steps.result: Submitted status, timestamp, and correct five photos displayed

steps.action: Verify shortlist and note editing are locked across screens
steps.result: No changes possible to selection or notes

steps.action: Reload page
steps.result: Submitted state remains locked

workflows.success: Client successfully submitted selection and verified it's locked
workflows.failure: Submission allowed with fewer than five or state not locked after reload
workflows.recovery: Select exactly five photos, then submit again, and reload to confirm lock

workflows.name: Start over

steps.action: Open Start over dialog and cancel
steps.result: All submitted data remains intact

steps.action: Open Start over dialog again and confirm reset
steps.result: Empty Draft selection and cleared notes

steps.action: Reload page
steps.result: Reset persists across reload

workflows.success: Client successfully started over from submitted state
workflows.failure: Reset doesn't clear selection or notes properly
workflows.recovery: Manually clear selection, reload page, and verify reset works
